'''''Assault at Selonia''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]]. It is the second volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy]]'', following ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'' and preceding ''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''. It was first published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[June]] [[1995]].
